cards.text: Friend, Amos, one of the sheepherders of Tekoa (Amos 1:1), has been bringing Israel HEAVY news: God says He'll destroy the sinful kingdom from the face of the earth (Amos 9:8). Now the LORD looks ahead to "that day," and He talks about the fallen tent of David, Israel's king. And friend, that tent is DOWN: gaps, ruins, the works.

cards.question: The tent of David has fallen, full of gaps and ruins. What does the LORD promise to do with it?

answers.text: Rebuild it like it was long ago
Leave it in ruins as a warning
Tear down what is left of it

cards.question: The LORD says He will rebuild the tent of David "that they may possess" something. What is it?

answers.text: Edom's remnant and the nations bearing His name
Philistia's cities and the whole land of Moab
Egypt's fields and the faraway land of Cush

cards.text: Edom is the nation that came from Esau, Jacob's brother (Genesis 36:9). And the LORD seals the whole promise: "…declares the LORD, who will do this."

cards.question: The LORD says the days are coming when "…the plowman will overtake the reaper…" What does that picture show?

answers.text: Plowing starting before the reaping is done
Fields lying unplowed for many years
Reapers leaving the grain in the field

cards.text: Same with the treader of grapes catching up to the sower of seed. That's me still pulling one batch out of the oven while the NEXT batch of dough is tapping me on the shoulder like, 'Papa. Papa. PAPA. We're READY.'
And the LORD keeps going: "The mountains will drip with sweet wine, with which all the hills will flow."

cards.question: The LORD says He will restore His people Israel from captivity, and they will rebuild the ruined cities and ___ them.

cards.text: Then the LORD gets to the vineyards. Earlier in Amos, God told the people of Israel who trampled the poor that they wouldn't drink the wine of the vineyards they planted (Amos 5:11).

cards.question: This time, the LORD says His people will plant vineyards and drink their wine.

cards.text: Same with the gardens: they make them, and they eat their fruit. That's finishing the big project at work and actually getting the credit, with no coworker jumping in at the meeting like, 'Sooo, I had this idea…'

cards.question: The LORD says He will firmly plant His people in their own land. What does He promise about them staying there?

answers.text: They will never again be uprooted
They will be uprooted once more
They will move on to a new land

cards.question: The LORD says the land Israel is planted in is land they won for themselves.

cards.text: It closes with "says the LORD your God," the last words of the whole book of Amos. After all those hard warnings, the final word is a PROMISE, friend, and I'm over here crying into my apron like it's the end of a movie.
